name: Xarsi
source:
What? Why are you looking at me like that? Do you think I'm sort kind of devilish monster? I'll have you know, I used to be a nun! But after a little taste of sin, well... let's say I converted.

What's wrong with leading people down a path of temptation? Temptation leads to wonderful things. I don't eat people's souls. I set them free.
[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2052836802/wicked-willow/description[/url]the Kickstarter campaign].
